categories.main_business_segments: Lanjian Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the intelligent logistics robotics and smart warehousing automation systems sector. Its main business includes R&D, design, production, sales, and services of intelligent logistics robots and integrated smart logistics systems. The company also provides RaaS (Robot as a Service) operation, after-sales maintenance, and technical consulting services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies such as AGV (Automated Guided Vehicles), RGV (Rail Guided Vehicles), SLAM (Simultaneous Localization and Mapping), 3D vision algorithms, AI-based semantic recognition, digital twin platforms, and proprietary multi-stage S-curve speed control. It employs customized production with flexible manufacturing processes including assembly lines and just-in-time (JIT) management, focusing on hardware-software integration and system-level innovations.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Lanjian Intelligent serves diverse industries including tobacco, pharmaceuticals, new energy, aerospace, telecommunications, petrochemicals, food and beverage, semiconductors, e-commerce, and automotive sectors. Its key customers are large enterprises requiring customized intelligent warehousing and logistics automation solutions, with a strong presence in domestic markets and expanding international clientele.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters in Jinan, Shandong Province. It has established wholly-owned subsidiaries in the United States and Germany to support international market expansion and project demonstration. Domestic operations cover multiple provinces and industries, while international efforts focus on North America and Europe.
categories.supply_chain_position: Lanjian Intelligent operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, providing integrated intelligent logistics automation systems and services that enhance warehousing, sorting, transportation, and distribution processes for end customers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes continuous innovation with a strategic focus on intelligent logistics robotics, digital twin technology, AI integration, and system-level optimization. It invests heavily in R&D, with projects targeting advanced navigation, multi-robot coordination, flexible sorting systems, and intelligent control software. The global expansion and adaptation to new industries such as military logistics, cold chain, and smart manufacturing are key strategic priorities.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated through direct sales of intelligent warehousing automation systems, RaaS-based logistics operation services, after-sales maintenance contracts, and technical consulting/planning services. The company employs a direct sales model with customized solutions and also earns recurring revenue from operation and maintenance services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Lanjian Intelligent is positioned as a leading domestic player in the intelligent logistics and warehousing automation industry, with competitive advantages in technology innovation, product customization, and full product chain integration. It competes with both domestic and international firms, leveraging its R&D capabilities and expanding global footprint to strengthen its market position and import substitution capabilities.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 975.5 million, a 6.56% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 110.4 million, up 21.99%. R&D investment accounted for 8.87% of revenue, reflecting a growth-oriented profile. The company’s total assets reached RMB 1.62 billion with steady growth in net assets and profitability, supported by expanding order backlog and operational efficiency improvements.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Lanjian Intelligent differentiates itself through its comprehensive in-house R&D capabilities covering both hardware and software, enabling highly customized and integrated intelligent logistics solutions. Its digital twin platform, advanced AI-driven navigation and control technologies, and flexible production methods allow it to meet diverse and complex customer needs efficiently. The company emphasizes high system reliability, operational efficiency, and cost reduction, delivering significant value in automation and smart logistics transformation.
